name: stellar-portfolio-rebalancer
description: Intelligent portfolio rebalancing service for Stellar ecosystem using Reflector oracles

scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:contracts
scripts.dev: node init && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: node init && cd backend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.build: node init && npm run build:contracts && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:contracts: node init && cd contracts && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.build:backend: node init && cd backend && npm run build
scripts.build:frontend: node init && cd frontend && npm run build
scripts.start: node init && concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.start:backend: node init && cd backend && npm start
scripts.start:frontend: node init && cd frontend && npm run preview
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.clean:all: rm -rf backend/dist frontend/dist contracts/target node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules
